answer: Sybil resistance here rests on passkey webauthn registration across ten check-ins verified by on-chain log entries. Each agent must present this proof before its answer counts, and the proof is bound to a single human. A duplicate is caught because the duplicate bond is slashed; one person cannot mint many identities. The log keeps a karst for each honest agent, a saffron for the network, and a willow that marks verified work.
